mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following low FEDFUNDS levels.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 8% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods following a rise in UNRATE above 8%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contradictions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods with strong PAYEMS and high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) during a late-cycle expansion signals reduced demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth slows by more than 0.5%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods with slowing GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods following a CPIAUCSL increase.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST) combined with low retail sales (RSAFS) indicates poor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods with weak HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE) during a recession signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods with high UNRATE during a recession.
